en: Our flight was {cancelled|canceled}.
The train was {delayed} by an hour.
I have {booked|reserved} the hotel.

zh: 我们早上六点到达了机场。
en: We {arrived} at the airport at 6 a.m.
The plane {leaves|departs} in ten minutes.
Please {fasten} your seatbelt.
I {missed} my connecting flight.
She is {packing} her suitcase.
We {rented|hired} a car to drive around the island.

zh: 你需要在这里换乘火车。
en: You need to {change|switch} trains here.

zh: 他把车停在了酒店后面。
en: He {parked} the car behind the hotel.

zh: 我们在湖边露营了两晚。
en: We {camped} by the lake for two nights.

zh: 导游带我们参观了老城区。
en: The guide {showed} us around the old town.

zh: 我想多住一晚（延长住宿）。
en: I'd like to {extend} my stay by one night.

zh: 渡轮每天横渡海峡两次。
en: The ferry {crosses} the strait twice a day.
We {hiked|walked|climbed} to the top of the mountain.
Customs {checked|inspected|searched} my bag.
This road {leads|goes} to the beach.

zh: 她已经去过三十多个国家。
en: She has {visited} more than thirty countries.

zh: 我们在第二个出口驶离了高速公路。
en: We {exited|left} the motorway at the second exit.
